text:
Rae: Doubleheader tonight. whos up for stadium nachos vs office nachos debate? :nachos:
Omar: Stadium nachos > office nachos. hot take.
Kai: I will fight you for that take. office nachos have heart (and more jalapeos).
Sofia: also tiny office pool: $3 on whether the tie-breaker goes to extra innings. winner picks snack.
Rae: Im in. putting $3 on extra innings.
Omar: Ill take regulation win, and I want the pretzel bites if I win.
RemoteLee: joining from PST, will cheer quietly. post the stream link pls.
Kai: link: https://watch.example.com/game (pw: bluebird). pinning in channel.
OpsBot: Room "Commons" booked 18:30-21:30 for "Doubleheader Watch & Nacho Vote" organizer: Rae.
Sofia: Quick poll: classic cheese or loaded with chili? react with :cheese: or :hot_pepper:.
Rae: :hot_pepper:
Omar: :cheese:
Kai: :hot_pepper: (but only mildly)
RemoteLee: :cheese: (remote preference)
Sofia: Vote tally: cheese 2, hot_pepper 2. tie! Rae wins tie-break coin toss. nachos will be loaded.
Omar: this is an outrage but also I love chili so fine.
Rae: reminder: bring cash $3 and your loudest "lets go". loser stocks snacks for the week.
Kai: I will absolutely lose but provide enthusiastic support.
Rae: halftime challenge: best stadium chant imitation wins an extra point. whoever nails it gets the tiny foam finger.
Omar: im practicing my deep baritone chant. watch out.
RemoteLee: If I win remotely, can I get a miniature foam finger mailed?
Sofia: yes but only if you send a selfie with it.
OpsBot: Match update scheduled: goal alerts enabled for channel.
Rae: ok see you all at 6.30. may the best nacho-lover prevail :taco:
